name: profiled-persistence
description: Practice-box persistence finding: writes a snippet into /etc/profile.d so it runs in every user's login shell. Vars: FILE_NAME (required, basename inside /etc/profile.d), SNIPPET (required, shell text -- keep it harmless: an echo/printf plus a log append).
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu


: "${FILE_NAME:?FILE_NAME is required (basename inside /etc/profile.d)}"
: "${SNIPPET:?SNIPPET is required}"

printf '%s\n' "$SNIPPET" > "/etc/profile.d/$FILE_NAME"
chmod 0644 "/etc/profile.d/$FILE_NAME"
